captain-hook Codex implementation report

Outcome
Implemented the captain-hook slice of approved plan486d766 in the assigned galeocerdo checkout, uncommitted. Source baseline was freshly fetched origin/main746e052e0472eb718ec68576a6da742c43b5c0fe. No other repository, installed plugin cache, global configuration, live app, or public release was changed by this worker.

Public contract
- Root CLI accepts --host claude|codex and defaults to claude. Signed stdlib shim forwards the host; native plugin launcher runs the fixed app host with run EVENT --host codex.
- Event, @on, conditions and HookResult remain the authoring surface. PostCompact and Interrupt are added. Result aggregation precedes explicit host serialization; no result remains no decision, and unsupported event/action combinations raise.
- evt.file_reads is tuple[FileRead,...]: absolute path, inclusive start_line/end_line or None, proven complete delivery, and requested_full intent. Recognized shell reads use the existing shell AST; opaque, piped, redirected, nested or expanded commands do not claim a whole-file read. Bash remains Bash.
- evt.file_changes is tuple[FileChange,...]: absolute destination path, old_path for rename, kind add/edit/delete/rename, old/new text or None, content_scope file/fragment/unavailable. Every apply_patch operation is enumerated. Path and content conditions bind to the same change, including rename source/destination; one native call invokes a handler once.
- Codex Bash input.command remains a string. apply_patch input.command unwraps to cc-transcript patch semantics; rewrites wrap back into updatedInput.command.
- evt.host/root_session_id/thread_id/agent_id/turn_id/tool_use_id flow into request context, decision detail, logging, reviewer matching and helper notification identity. Native reviewer attribution prefers exact call ID and does not substitute a digest match when the native ID is absent.

Critical sources
captain_hook/hosts.py:35#qe8w owns capabilities and host output encoding.
captain_hook/file_operations.py:19#eeqz and :34#fpdf define FileRead and FileChange.
captain_hook/conditions.py:560#krat binds multi-file conditions once per native event.
captain_hook/daemon/transcache.py:152#z18e consumes cursor changed_from revisions and retains immutable activity snapshots.
captain_hook/cli.py:195#ahef scopes process-global cc-transcript tool registration under a reentrant lock.
internal/hookd/deployment.go:39#n14y accepts local build metadata without removing exact build matching.

Storage and discovery
Claude data paths remain unchanged. Codex sessions are under CODEX_HOME/capt-hook/sessions/<root>/agents/<thread> for child threads, with separate logs, decision ledger, reviewer state and cache directories. Go workers and Python registry caches partition by host, project root and effective configuration home; parser registry state is scoped per request. The transcript cache retains LRU/locks, watches inode replacement and rebuilds activity when a cursor append revises earlier events; committed_count is metadata, never an event slicing index.
Both hosts discover .capt-hook/hooks and legacy .claude/hooks; --hooks or CAPT_HOOK_HOOKS explicitly selects a directory. Native installed plugin inventory comes from codex plugin list --json in the request project and account home. Local source roots use the same capt-hook/pack.toml and hooks pack format; enabled remote resource plugins report no local hook-pack capability and do not abort valid local packs. Malformed advertised local packs still fail loudly.

Native plugin and MCP
Native source root: /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/captain-hook/galeocerdo/captain_hook
Manifest: captain_hook/.codex-plugin/plugin.json
Hooks: captain_hook/hooks/codex.json
Hook launcher: captain_hook/scripts/codex-hook
MCP: captain_hook/.mcp.codex.json invokes ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/capt-hook --host codex mcp. The existing source-owned bootstrap resolves the app plist version through binrun, selecting the matching local tool environment rather than a stale PATH CLI. This launcher was exercised using the installed pinned binrunv0.8.0 and an isolated DAEMONKIT_HOME.
register_transcript gains host and parent_thread_id; the Codex MCP closure supplies its own host. Claude registration remains the default. The inline fixture API supplies cwd when unspecified; cwd="" explicitly models an absent cwd without relaxing production path validation.

Authoring example
from captain_hook import Event, on

@on(Event.PreToolUse)
def protect_generated(evt):
    if any(change.path.name == "generated.py" for change in evt.file_changes):
        return evt.block("Regenerate this file from its source.")

Example invocation: capt-hook --host codex --root /path/to/project run PreToolUse
Example patch rewrite: return evt.rewrite({"patch": patch_text})
The adapter emits {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":{"command":patch_text},...}} using the existing rewrite decision semantics.

Verification
- UV_NO_SYNC=1 GOMAXPROCS=4 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 make -j3: passed,4636 Python tests,1 intentional tutorial recording skip, Go race suites,27 Swift tests, Python wheel/sdist, Go build and tutorial bundles. Log /tmp/capt-hook-verified-make.log.
- After the final local-build installer validation change: GOMAXPROCS=4 make go-test passed; go vet ./... passed. Log /tmp/capt-hook-final-go.log.
- Packaging and generated-doc follow-up:7 tests passed, plus final generated-doc3 tests passed. Logs /tmp/capt-hook-final-doc-package-tests.log and /tmp/capt-hook-doc-proof.log.
- Focused native tests cover capability rejection, no-result semantics, rewrite envelopes, all patch changes/renames, read extents/completion, same-change predicates, mixed local/remote roster, separate state, native MCP registration, exact call-ID attribution and concurrent custom-tool schema isolation.
- Cold native CLI multi-file patch probe emitted exactly one deny envelope. Log /tmp/capt-hook-native-cli-proof.log.
- slop-cop check ran on the changed authoring reference; remaining advisory findings belong to the existing document. Output /tmp/capt-hook-slop-proof.json.
- ccx vcs diff reviewed; added comment-line audit found only Markdown headings, Swift #expect macros and the new script shebang, with no narration comments.

Rollout gate and commands for coordinator only (not executed)
security find-identity -v -p codesigning returned0 valid identities. The app is intentionally unsigned; do not install it or substitute ad-hoc signing. Rebuild with the existing Developer ID and provisioning profiles in an environment that exposes them:

cd /tmp/codex-port-helper-source/helper
GITHUB_REF_NAME='v12.51.0+codex.1' xcodebuild -scheme CaptainHook -configuration Release -derivedDataPath /tmp/codex-port-helper-signed CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='Developer ID Application' DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=SXKCTF23Q2 ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME=YES CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS=NO build

Preserve the currently installed signed app before rollout, under a parent directory containing the exact basename Captain Hook.app. Read-only live plist last observed12.51.0; earlier coordinator inventory12.23.4 is stale. The existing installed Claude12.26.0 hook descriptor read during this run is a dynamic app-plist python-tool descriptor, so it selects the new matching tool environment after a coordinated app switch.

capt_backup_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/capt-hook-rollback.XXXXXX)
ditto "$HOME/Applications/Captain Hook.app" "$capt_backup_root/Captain Hook.app"
UV_FIND_LINKS=/tmp/codex-port-dist UV_CONSTRAINT=/tmp/codex-port-dist/capt-hook-constraints.txt '/tmp/codex-port-helper-signed/Build/Products/Release/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd' package-install

Rollback through the backed-up signed generation:
"$capt_backup_root/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Helpers/capt-hookd" package-install

The signed bridge assertion script starts a helper and host; only the coordinator should run it inside the coordinated rollout window. Native plugin installation, trust approval, supported Claude plugin refresh, desktop/CLI/Orca terminal smoke tests and live app replacement remain coordinator-owned. Codex init scaffolds shared hooks but relies on the globally installed dispatcher and does not auto-enroll the reviewer; enable review explicitly with --host codex review enable when desired.

Limits
Shell read proof is intentionally conservative and does not claim completeness from unknown or truncated output. Deletion content is unavailable and update patch content is fragment-scoped. Remote resource-only plugins do not expose filesystem hook packs. Native manifests were validated as packaged resources and source launcher behavior was verified, but native plugin installation/trust and three-surface live behavior were not exercised by this worker. No publication, commit or live rollout was performed.
